purpose: Preserve independently learned embodied Scene Gen/Transfer, legally and reproducibly, without archive format duplication

additions.group: Embodied multi-view Scene Gen and Transfer: Xiaomi UNIS 4B autoregressive original
additions.reason_selected: Separate posttrained UNIS image-token AR world model for robot-view-consistent Scene Gen and embodied Transfer. Existing Wan/Cosmos/Praxis model objectives and learned states differ. Save one 4B original only, along with Emu3.5 separately trained IBQ visual tokenizer; do not add 4B-Sequence/34B/38B siblings without distinct measured evidence.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher revision c1a4e9c9c3cf52dd3617d3c9c974e16e6e88b3cd has 2 BF16 original weights, exact LFS SHA256 and bytes, 5.0821B main model reported. External BAAI VQ 455.3M learned model pinned to 40-char revision and 1 safetensors SHA/byte; official pinned code documents 4B AR eager scene/transfer inference.
additions.quality_negative: External VQ model.ckpt auto-loader executes torch.load if paired with config.yaml; chosen safetensors needs custom AutoModel fallback trust_remote_code=True not verified safe or compatible offline. No standalone model repository LICENSE file, Apache2.0 tag is metadata not owner legal approval; vendor H20 FlashAR 34B/38B speed cannot describe this 4B. User HDD/cache/staging and same-HW quality untested.
additions.observed_access: Publisher API private:false and gated:false for both original and VQ; owner-specific rights and allowed acts not verified

parameter_gate.evidence_kind: HuggingFace model parameter summary 5.0821B plus BAAI external VQ 455.3M, 5.5374B known components; full inference total not locally verified

restriction_assessment.observed: Public ungated publisher listing, no takedown notice; APA license label. Model owner rights not authenticated
restriction_assessment.scenario: Future access and export restrictions possible, not confirmed as a blanket open-weight ban

preservation_bundle.learned_outcome: Multiview robot Scene Gen/Transfer with discrete vision-token AR learned state
must_preserve: original 2 sharded safetensors SHA/byte at fixed source commit
config/tokenizer custom code and token vocab
BAAI external learned Emu3.5 VisionTokenizer safetensors fixed commit and custom code
Xiaomi official source code commit and license notices plus ABI
excluded_duplicate_or_optional_formats: U0-4B Sequence distinct but unsupported incremental value
VQ alternative model.ckpt plus config.yaml unsafe implicit torch.load path
Depth Anything 3 conditional RGB transfer helper, not mandatory T2I

additions.falsification_condition: If existing selected models replicate robot multisensor/multiview scene transfer without new trained original, or the safe VQ code cannot restore without harmful deserialization, or rights/quality/capacity gates fail, downgrade or replace.

not_adopted.reason: Different LFS SHA but unique sequential video benefit unverified
